title: Israeli Air Strikes Kill 8 in Gaza, Including Two Children
detail: Israeli strikes across Gaza killed 8 Palestinians and wounded 12. A strike on a displaced-persons tent in al-Mawasi, Khan Younis killed at least 4 people including a 10-year-old child. Gunfire in Gaza City's Zeitoun neighbourhood killed a 6-year-old boy. A strike near a Gaza City school killed one person, and a vehicle strike west of Gaza City killed another. The Gaza Ministry of Health said 1,084 people had been killed by Israeli violations since the October 2025 truce began.

media.caption: Mourner at a funeral at Nasser Medical Complex, Khan Younis, following strikes that killed 8 including 2 children — July 8, 2026

title: World Central Kitchen Driver Shot Dead Delivering Aid Near Kerem Shalom Crossing
detail: Ahmad Nasser Saleem, a driver for a World Central Kitchen partner logistics company, was shot dead with his hands raised while transporting humanitarian aid from the Karem Abu Salem (Kerem Shalom) crossing to a WCK warehouse in Gaza. WCK said 'humanitarian aid deliveries should never be a target' and called for a full Israeli accounting of the killing. His father said he had been shot 'between the eyes' while on his way to 'bring food for the children.'

media.caption: World Central Kitchen confirms driver Ahmad Nasser Saleem killed by Israeli fire while transporting aid — July 8, 2026

title: US Rep. Ro Khanna Detained ~90 Minutes by Armed Israeli Settlers Near Khirbet Zanuta
detail: US Representative Ro Khanna said he and members of his delegation were blocked and detained for roughly 90 minutes by Israeli settlers, some carrying M4 rifles, near the depopulated Palestinian hamlet of Khirbet Zanuta in the South Hebron Hills. Khanna said that when IDF troops arrived they sided with the settlers rather than freeing the group; the Israeli military said troops were dispatched after a report of Israeli civilians unlawfully blocking vehicles, and that they dispersed the settlers and reopened the road. Khanna was released after contact with US embassy officials and Israeli police.

media.caption: US Rep. Ro Khanna speaks with a Palestinian resident during his West Bank visit — July 8, 2026
